blocks.text: Security tools and techniques help protect computers and networks from online threats. They make it harder for hackers or malicious software to access important information. These tools include authentication systems, firewalls, and antivirus programs that check and block harmful activities. Using them properly keeps personal data safe and reduces the chances of cyberattacks. Every computer user should understand and apply these tools to maintain digital safety.
